subsystem: Backend routes + controllers (routes/health-clinical.php + Clinical\* and HealthClinical\* controllers)

files.purpose: The single route file for the module. Loaded via routes/web.php:225 (require __DIR__.'/health-clinical.php'). Defines module pages, cross-client registers, client-scoped, behaviour/ABC, and shift-scoped clinical routes.
files.keyDetails:
ROUTE INVENTORY (name -> method URI -> permission middleware -> controller action -> renders/stores):
1. health-clinical.dashboard -> GET /health-clinical -> permission:clinical.dashboard -> Clinical\HealthClinicalDashboardController@index -> renders 'health-clinical/index' (THE live page; props kpis/overdue_items/recent_events/recent_observations).
2. health-clinical.observations.index -> GET /health-clinical/observations -> permission:clinical.observations.viewAny -> Clinical\HealthClinicalDashboardController@observations -> renders 'health-clinical/observations' (paginated register; filters client_id, observation_type, recorded_by, site_id, date_from, date_to).
3. health-clinical.observations.store -> POST /health-clinical/observations -> permission:clinical.observations.record -> **HealthClinical\HealthClinicalController@storeObservation** (the OLD namespace) -> back()->with('success').
4. health-clinical.events.index -> GET /health-clinical/events -> permission:clinical.events.viewAny -> Clinical\HealthClinicalDashboardController@events -> renders 'health-clinical/Events' (paginated register; filters client_id, event_type, severity, site_id, follow_up_status[none|required|pending|completed], review_status[reviewed|unreviewed], date_from/to).
5. health-clinical.events.store -> POST /health-clinical/events -> permission:clinical.events.record -> **HealthClinical\HealthClinicalController@storeEvent** (the OLD namespace) -> back()->with('success').
6. health-clinical.protocols.index -> GET /health-clinical/protocols -> permission:clinical.protocols.viewAny|clinical.protocols.manage -> Clinical\HealthClinicalProtocolController@index -> renders 'health-clinical/Protocols'.
7. health-clinical.protocols.create -> GET /health-clinical/protocols/create -> permission:clinical.protocols.manage -> @create -> renders 'health-clinical/protocols/Create'.
8. health-clinical.protocols.store -> POST /health-clinical/protocols -> permission:clinical.protocols.manage -> @store.
9. health-clinical.protocols.edit -> GET /health-clinical/protocols/{protocol}/edit -> permission:clinical.protocols.manage -> @edit -> renders 'health-clinical/protocols/Edit'.
10. health-clinical.protocols.update -> PUT /health-clinical/protocols/{protocol} -> permission:clinical.protocols.manage -> @update.
11. health-clinical.protocols.toggle-active -> PATCH /health-clinical/protocols/{protocol}/toggle-active -> permission:clinical.protocols.manage -> @toggleActive.
12. health-clinical.clients.trends -> GET /health-clinical/clients/{client}/trends -> permission:clinical.observations.viewAny|clinical.observations.viewAssigned -> Clinical\HealthClinicalClientTrendsController@show -> renders 'health-clinical/ClientTrends'.
13. health-clinical.clients.summary -> GET /health-clinical/clients/{client}/summary -> permission:clinical.observations.viewAny|...viewAssigned -> HealthClinical\HealthClinicalController@clientSummary -> renders 'health-clinical/ClientSummary'.
14. clients.clinical.observations.index -> GET /clients/{client}/clinical/observations -> (no perm mw; policy authorize('view',client)) -> Clinical\ClientClinicalController@observations -> JSON.
15. clients.clinical.observations.store -> POST /clients/{client}/clinical/observations -> Clinical\ClientClinicalController@store -> JSON or back(). **THIS is the rich store path the wizard should use.**
16. clients.clinical.events.store -> POST /clients/{client}/clinical/events -> Clinical\ClientClinicalController@storeEvent.
17. clients.behaviour.abc.index -> GET /clients/{client}/behaviour/abc -> Clinical\BehaviourAbcController@index -> JSON paginated.
18. clients.behaviour.abc.store -> POST .../abc -> @store.
19. clients.behaviour.abc.show -> GET .../abc/{abc} -> @show -> JSON.
20. clients.behaviour.abc.update -> PUT .../abc/{abc} -> @update.
21. clients.behaviour.abc.destroy -> DELETE .../abc/{abc} -> @destroy.
22. shifts.clinical.observations.due -> GET /shifts/{shift}/clinical/observations/due -> ShiftClinicalController@dueObservations -> JSON.
23. shifts.clinical.observations.store -> POST .../observations -> @store.
24. shifts.clinical.events.store -> POST .../events -> @storeEvent.
NOTE: routes 14-24 have NO permission middleware on the route; perm checks are inline in each action (authorize('view',$client) + canDo()).

files.purpose: The LIVE module controller (Clinical namespace). Renders the dashboard ('health-clinical/index'), observations register, and events register. Backed by App\Domain\Clinical\Services\ClinicalDashboardService.

files.purpose: OLDER duplicate controller (HealthClinical namespace, App\Services\HealthClinical\* + App\Models\ClinicalObservation/ClinicalEvent). Only 3 of its 9 methods are route-wired: storeObservation, storeEvent, clientSummary. dashboard/observations/events/protocols/storeProtocol/updateProtocol are DEAD (no route references them).
files.keyDetails: storeObservation() [WIRED as observations.store]: validates client_id,shift_id,clinical_protocol_id(NOTE: NOT protocol_schedule_id),observation_type,data(array, NO per-type validation),notes,recorded_at. Calls App\Services\HealthClinical\ClinicalObservationService@record -> writes App\Models\ClinicalObservation. files.purpose: Client-profile-scoped clinical recording (Clinical namespace). The RICH store path the redesign wizards should reuse for observations + events. JSON-or-Inertia content negotiation.
files.keyDetails: store(): authorize('view',$client) + canDo('clinical.observations.record' OR 'recordClinical'); validates observation_type[Rule::in ObservationType cases],data(present|array),notes(max:2000),recorded_at(date),protocol_schedule_id(exists:clinical_protocol_schedules,id). Enforces type->requiresClinicalPermission() => needs recordClinical for vitals/pain. Calls App\Domain\Clinical\Services\ClinicalObservationService@record($client,$user,$validated) which runs validateDataForType, sets site_id, emits timeline + ObservationRecorded, completes protocol_schedule. storeEvent(): authorize('view') + canDo('clinical.events.record'); validates event_type,severity[AlertSeverity::ALL],occurred_at,description(max5000),immediate_action_taken,outcome,requires_followup(bool),followup_notes. Calls Domain ClinicalEventService@record -> HS auto-link + signals + timeline. **DROPS 'witnesses'** (service accepts it, controller validator omits it; design 7.2 flags this).

files.purpose: Protocols register + create/edit/store/update/toggle-active (Clinical namespace, owned by this module). Full-page Create/Edit currently; design suggests promoting to modal wizard but backend is reusable as-is.
files.keyDetails: index(): authorize('viewAny',ClinicalProtocol::class); filters client_id,observation_type,frequency,status[active|inactive]; getProtocolRegister+getProtocolRegisterStats; can_manage flag. Validated protocol fields: name(req,max255), observation_type[ObservationType], frequency[ProtocolFrequency], custom_frequency_hours(required_if frequency=custom,1-8760), instructions(max4000), alert_if_missed_hours(req,1-8760), is_active(bool), starts_at, ends_at(after_or_equal:starts_at). On UPDATE with schedule history, observation_type/frequency/custom_frequency_hours are 'prohibited' (immutable once scheduled); client_id always prohibited on update. files.purpose: Per-client Trends page ('health-clinical/ClientTrends'). Builds weight/pain/vitals/fluid_intake trend point arrays from Domain ClinicalObservationService->getTrends. Read-only.

gaps.description: TWO PARALLEL STACKS and the wizard store routes point at the WEAKER one. observations.store + events.store (the two endpoints the redesign wizards POST to) are wired to HealthClinical\HealthClinicalController, which uses App\Services\HealthClinical\* services + App\Models\ClinicalObservation/ClinicalEvent. These do NO per-type data validation, do NOT set site_id, do NOT emit timeline/ObservationRecorded/ClinicalEventRecorded events, do NOT auto-link events to HS, use mismatched field names (event: 'follow_up_required'/'metadata'/'linked_observation_id'; obs: 'clinical_protocol_id' not 'protocol_schedule_id'), and DROP the wizard's immediate_action_taken/outcome/witnesses/requires_followup/followup_notes. The rich, correct implementation already exists in App\Domain\Clinical\Services\* (used by ClientClinicalController) but the MODULE-level routes do not call it. The redesign MUST repoint health-clinical.observations.store + events.store to the Domain services (ideally a shared store action taking an optional client, per design 8), NOT extend the old controller.

Event REVIEW / FOLLOW-UP / ESCALATE endpoints do not exist (design 3.2). No route or controller action sets reviewed_at/reviewed_by, followup_completed_at/by, or escalates; despite the columns + reviewer/followupCompleter relations + the clinical.events.review permission all already existing. Need: PATCH /health-clinical/events/{event}/review (gate clinical.events.review), PATCH /health-clinical/events/{event}/follow-up/complete, POST /health-clinical/events/{event}/escalate. Note the existing event register already filters on review_status/follow_up_status, so the read side is ready; only the mutating actions are missing.

No cross-client BEHAVIOUR/ABC index endpoint (design 3.4). BehaviourAbcController is entirely client-scoped (clients/{client}/behaviour/abc). The Behaviour tab needs GET /health-clinical/behaviour with client_id + behaviour_function filters + pagination + aggregates (most-common function, restraint-episode count). Design 3.4 proposes a new clinical.behaviour.viewAny permission, but writes can keep reusing clinical.events.record.

No cross-client HEALTH MONITORING rollup endpoint (design 3.3). Fluid/bowel/seizure/sleep capture is per-client only (the health-monitoring profile tab posts to /operations/clients/{client}/health/*). The module's Health Monitoring tab needs a cross-client read endpoint (filter by site + date range). Design suggests a HealthMonitoringRollupService or extending ClinicalDashboardService; proposed new permission clinical.monitoring.viewAny.

No structured-vitals / NEWS2 backend (design 3.1, the biggest item). Vitals stored as free-form data JSON (systolic/diastolic/pulse + optional temperature/respiration_rate/o2_saturation per ClinicalObservationService::validateVitals). No ACVPU/consciousness, no on_oxygen flag, no news2_score/news2_band column, no News2Scorer service, no deterioration-watch escalation. The hero watchlist, the wizard's live NEWS2, the Trends NEWS2 chart, and getKpis().clients_on_watch all depend on this. Routes/controllers can't surface NEWS2 until the schema+scorer land (separate subsystem, but the store actions and dashboard controller will need extending).

No attachments/evidence endpoints for clinical events or ABC (design 10). ClinicalEvent/ClinicalObservation/BehaviourAbcEntry have no attachments relation. The Log-Event and Record-ABC wizards need single-file POST /health-clinical/events/{event}/attachments and .../behaviour/{entry}/attachments (+ DELETE) to drive the shared AttachmentUploader. Requires a polymorphic clinical_attachments table + morphMany + endpoints gated clinical.events.record / clinical.behaviour.record.

getKpis() likely missing several hero fields (design 3.5): clients_on_watch (needs NEWS2), restraint_register_current (bool, source H&S /restraints), nga_paerewa_certified (bool, source governance) for the compliance chips. events_unreviewed/events_pending_followup may already exist via getEventRegisterStats but are not confirmed in getKpis(). Must verify ClinicalDashboardService::getKpis() body before building the hero.

DEAD CODE: HealthClinical\HealthClinicalController has 6 unwired methods: dashboard() (renders dead health-clinical/Dashboard.tsx), observations(), events(), protocols(), storeProtocol(), updateProtocol(). No route references them. Their existence (plus the App\Models\ClinicalObservation/ClinicalEvent + App\Services\HealthClinical\* duplicate stack) is a strong duplication/confusion risk for the implementer. Dashboard.tsx is confirmed dead (route renders 'health-clinical/index'). Recommend retiring this controller + the App\Services\HealthClinical\* services + the App\Models\Clinical* duplicates after repointing the 2 store routes.

No debounced GET /clients/search?q= endpoint surfaced for the wizards/pickers (design 9 cross-cutting #1, NHI search). Registers paginate server-side already, but the shared client-search component the design relies on needs a backend search route (id, name, preferred name, NHI, site).

Permissions clinical.events.escalate, clinical.behaviour.viewAny, clinical.monitoring.viewAny do not exist in ClinicalPermissionsSeeder (only clinical.events.review, which IS present). New abilities must be added to ClinicalPermissionsSeeder + run on deploy (seeders are skipped on deploy per reference_deploy_seeders; new perm-gated routes will 403 on server until ClinicalPermissionsSeeder --force is run).

client-scoped + shift-scoped + ABC routes (14-24) carry NO route-level permission middleware; perm checks are inline in each action. If the redesign adds module-level mirror routes, keep the same inline pattern OR add explicit middleware, but do NOT assume route-level gating exists today.

notes:
TWO-NAMESPACE VERDICT: it is DUPLICATION, not clean division of labour. There are two parallel clinical stacks: (A) App\Domain\Clinical\* (models, enums, services) the modern, richer, event-emitting, HS-linking, per-type-validated implementation used by Clinical\ClientClinicalController, ShiftClinicalController, HealthClinicalDashboardController, HealthClinicalClientTrendsController, HealthClinicalProtocolController. (B) App\Models\ClinicalObservation/ClinicalEvent + App\Services\HealthClinical\* an older, thinner implementation used ONLY by HealthClinical\HealthClinicalController. The danger: the redesign's two most-used write endpoints, route names health-clinical.observations.store and health-clinical.events.store, are wired to the OLD (B) controller, so wizard payloads currently hit the weak path (no validation, no site_id, no timeline/events, no HS auto-link, mismatched field names). The implementer must repoint those two routes to the (A) Domain stack (sharing ClientClinicalController's logic via an extracted action) and then retire the (B) controller + services + duplicate models + the dead health-clinical/Dashboard.tsx page. Six methods on the (B) controller (dashboard/observations/events/protocols/storeProtocol/updateProtocol) are already dead (no route hits them).

DE-DUP within the redesign: per design 11, Care Plans and Restraint register are read-only LENSES; do NOT add registers here; link to existing /care-plans (Operations\CarePlanController) and /restraints (H&S RestraintController). Confirmed no health-clinical route owns those.

SURPRISE / GOOD NEWS: clinical.events.review permission already exists in the seeder (design 5 lists it as new). The ClinicalEvent model already has every review/follow-up/escalation column + relations + scopes, so 3.2 is purely a routes+actions gap, the data layer is done. The event register already filters on review_status & follow_up_status, so the read side for review/sign-off is also done.

PAGE-NAME COLLISION RISK on Windows/case-insensitive FS: the live Domain controller renders 'health-clinical/observations' (lowercase observations.tsx) while the dead (B) controller renders 'health-clinical/Observations' (capital). Both Events register actions render 'health-clinical/Events'. When refactoring to tabs, consolidate page names.

No cross-client behaviour or health-monitoring index exists anywhere (confirmed by grep): 3.3/3.4 are genuinely net-new endpoints. Routes 14-24 (client/shift/ABC scoped) have NO route-level permission middleware; gating is inline per-action; don't assume otherwise when adding module mirror routes.

notes:
DEFINITIVE DUPLICATION VERDICT (the most important thing the redesign must respect): there are TWO parallel stacks. (1) The LIVE/canonical stack = App\Domain\Clinical\{Models,Services,Enums} backed by the standalone migrations 2026_04_13_100000_create_clinical_observations_table + _100001_create_clinical_events_table + _100002_create_clinical_protocols_table + _100003_create_clinical_protocol_schedules_table. (2) A STALE/orphaned stack = App\Models\Clinical* + App\Services\HealthClinical\* backed by migration 2026_04_13_100000_create_health_clinical_tables.php.

WHY the Domain stack wins: create_health_clinical_tables.php opens with `foreach(...tables) if(Schema::hasTable($table)) return;` and Laravel runs migrations in filename order — at the identical _100000 timestamp, 'create_clinical_observations_table' sorts BEFORE 'create_health_clinical_tables', so the standalone migrations create the tables first and the health_clinical bundle no-ops entirely. RESULT: the physical clinical_events/clinical_observations/clinical_protocols tables have the DOMAIN columns (witnesses, is_flagged, protocol_schedule_id, requires_followup, name, custom_frequency_hours, threshold_rules, etc.) and DO NOT have the old columns (metadata, follow_up_required, clinical_protocol_id, next_due_at, last_recorded_at, custom_interval_days). The old App\Models\Clinical* models and App\Services\HealthClinical services therefore reference non-existent columns and a divergent event-type enum — any write through them (HealthClinicalController::storeObservation/storeEvent/storeProtocol, ProtocolService::create) will drop fields or throw. They survive only because no test hits them and the dashboard/registers read exclusively through Domain.

IMPLICATIONS FOR THE REDESIGN: (a) Wire every wizard/register to App\Domain\Clinical\Services\* — treat the entire App\Services\HealthClinical\{ClinicalObservationService,ClinicalEventService,ProtocolService} + the un-routed HealthClinicalController methods (dashboard/observations/protocols/storeProtocol/updateProtocol) as dead code to delete; only storeObservation/storeEvent/clientSummary are routed and the first two are broken. (b) Repoint routes health-clinical.observations.store / events.store off HealthClinicalController onto a Domain-backed controller (clone ClientClinicalController's body). (c) Several design 'new' items already exist: clinical.events.review + clinical.observations.recordClinical + clinical.observations.correct permissions, the review() policy method, is_flagged/correction columns, witnesses column+cast, HS-linking, Control Room signals — reuse, don't rebuild. (d) Validation is INLINE in controllers (no FormRequest classes exist) — extend there. (e) The only true backend net-new work: News2Scorer + structured vitals columns, event review/follow-up/escalate endpoints, cross-client health-monitoring rollup, behaviour module index, clinical_attachments polymorphic table+endpoints, clinical_risk_assessments+scorers, and the 4 missing permissions (escalate/behaviour.viewAny/behaviour.record/monitoring.viewAny).

gaps.description: No hero+tab SHELL exists in the frontend. Today index/observations/Events/Protocols/ClientTrends are FIVE separate full pages, each with its own PageHero and its own back-to-Dashboard button — no shared shell, no tabs, no group pills. The redesign's single-hero, two-tier (Monitor/Plan/Analyse) tabbed shell must be built new, then the existing register page bodies dropped in as panels. This is the central front-end task.

The current hero is the basic PageHero (icon+stats+1 button) on every page — none use the command-centre chrome (eyebrow status pill, medallion, two stat clusters, NZ compliance chips, 7d/30d/90d period control, primary 'Record observation' + ghost 'Log clinical event' buttons). Must be rebuilt on hs-hero-kit. The current dashboard controller payload (kpis) lacks the extra hero fields the design expects (clients_on_watch, events_unreviewed/pending_followup, restraint_register_current, nga_paerewa_certified) — GAP §3.5.

Dashboard.tsx is dead code that must be deleted, and its renderer HealthClinicalController::dashboard/observations/events/protocols are unrouted dead methods (observations even renders a non-existent 'health-clinical/Observations' capital-O component). Two parallel controllers — App\Http\Controllers\HealthClinical\HealthClinicalController vs App\Http\Controllers\Clinical\HealthClinicalDashboardController/HealthClinicalProtocolController — render overlapping page names; only the Clinical-namespace ones are wired (plus clientSummary + storeObservation/storeEvent on HealthClinicalController). A wiring hazard the redesign should resolve so panels read from the right controller.

No NEWS2 column/score anywhere in observations.tsx or ClientTrends — the design's NEWS2 score pill in the register, deterioration-watch sparklines on Overview, and NEWS2 14d trend all need the structured-vitals + scorer backend (GAP §3.1) before the frontend can render them.

Events.tsx shows review/follow-up only as read-only badges — there is no review/sign-off, mark-follow-up-complete, or escalate ACTION, and no row context menu. The design needs these as ctx-menu actions backed by new endpoints (GAP §3.2: PATCH events/{event}/review, .../follow-up/complete, POST .../escalate).

No right-click context menu on any register row (observations/events/protocols all lack it). Design requires a cursor-anchored, viewport-flipping ctx menu (ShiftContextMenu/StreamContextMenu family) on every row, with items that open the record wizards pre-bound to the client.

No inline record entry points on any page — every register links OUT to /operations/clients/{id}; there is no module-level Record Observation / Log Clinical Event / Record ABC wizard. These 3 wizards must be built (reusing Add Client chrome) and wired to existing store endpoints (health-clinical.observations.store, health-clinical.events.store, clients.clinical.*). ABC has no module-level page at all today.

Four design tabs have NO existing page body to wrap: Health Monitoring (siloed on client profile), Care Plans (lens over /care-plans), Assessments & Risk (net-new, needs clinical_risk_assessments backend), Behaviour incl. Restraint register (ABC is per-client only; restraint lens over /restraints). Only Overview/Observations/Clinical Events/Protocols/Trends have a page to reuse — the other four panels are built new.

Filter UX gap: registers use Select dropdowns + Apply/Clear, not the design's free-text search box + filter chips + 'N shown' count + empty/loading states. Backend params already exist; this is a per-register toolbar rework (GAP §9). The design's shared debounced client-search component (GET /clients/search?q=, NHI-aware) does not exist yet.

ClientTrends.tsx hardcodes hex line colours (#059669, #dc2626, #2563eb, #0f766e, #f59e0b, #0891b2) directly in recharts <Line stroke>, violating the tokens-only rule. When repurposed into the Trends panel these must map to --status-* / --primary tokens.

ClientSummary.tsx and the standalone protocol Create/Edit pages have no place in the new tab IA. Decide their fate: ClientSummary -> retire/redirect once the wizard-rail clinical card covers it (or keep as a per-client deep link); Create/Edit -> promote to a create/edit modal and retire the standalone routes (GAP §7.4). Tests/links to these routes must be repointed.

gaps.description: No Health & Clinical command-centre hero exists yet. The current `/health-clinical` page (resources/js/pages/health-clinical/index.tsx) uses the generic PageHero with 4 flat stats + 1 button — NOT the two-cluster hs-hero-kit. The redesign must build a new hero by COMPOSING hs-hero-kit primitives (HeroShell/HeroStatusPill/HeroMedallion + two HeroCluster groups + HeroSegmented period + a clinical compliance-chip row). No new chrome primitives needed; pure composition.

HeroComplianceBadges in hs-hero-kit is hardcoded to H&S frameworks (WorkSafe notifiable, Ngā Paerewa, Hazardous Substances SDS, Fire drills, First aid) with a fixed 5-chip set and H&S-specific props. The design's clinical chips differ: 'Ngā Paerewa certified · deterioration watch · sign-off backlog · restraint register'. Reusing it verbatim is wrong — build a bespoke clinical chip row reusing only its CHIP_CLASS/CHIP_ICON token maps + the inline-flex chip markup. Do NOT extend HeroComplianceBadges with clinical props (it is shared by both H&S heroes and must read identically there).

Two different ShiftContextMenu components exist and the names collide. Canonical = re-exported from @/components/rostering (props {ctx,onClose}, types ShiftCtxItem/ShiftCtxState). A SECOND incompatible one lives at pages/operations/shifts/components/shift-context-menu.tsx (props {x,y,items,onClose}, ContextMenuItem type), and a third StreamContextMenu at pages/my-day/components/stream-context-menu.tsx (props {menu,onClose,onAction}, section arrays + 'Coming soon' tooltip). The redesign MUST import from @/components/rostering to avoid a prop-shape mismatch.

There is no shared two-tier group-pill nav COMPONENT — _groups.ts is only a data registry (key→group mapping); the client profile (show.tsx) renders its group pills + tier-2 tabs bespoke. The design's Monitor/Plan/Analyse group pills driving a TabStrip sub-tab row must be assembled by the implementer from TabStrip (or PageTabs) + a small group-pill row; no off-the-shelf 'two-tier nav' widget exists to drop in.

WizardShell is a controlled chrome (caller owns step state, validation, useForm, footer buttons). It does NOT bundle the step-gating/validation/jump-to-error logic that lives inside add-client-dialog. The 3 new wizards must re-implement the gating loop (validateStep + Continue-disabled + onError→goToStep) themselves — the design's 'Continue gated until client+type chosen' and 'live NEWS2 recompute' are caller responsibilities, not provided by the shell.

AttachmentUploader posts each file immediately to a live single-file endpoint (router.post). For the new-record wizards (Event/ABC) the record does not exist until the wizard submits, so attachments cannot upload mid-wizard the way the design's step-3 dropzone + Review attachment-count implies. Either (a) submit the record first then upload (two-phase), or (b) stage File[] in wizard form state using the lower-level FileDropzone + StagedFileCard (not AttachmentUploader) and send them with the create payload. A wiring decision for the implementer; the backend attachments table/endpoint is itself a separate backend gap (GAP doc §10.3).

No shared debounced client-search/select component exists for the wizards' step-1 picker, the Trends/Monitoring pickers, and register client-filter dropdowns. TilePicker renders a fixed option list (fine for ≤handful) but the design (§9) requires a searchable, server-paginated picker over the full roster (name/preferred/NHI/site). The rostering EntityFilter (exported from @/components/rostering) is a client-side filter dropdown, not a debounced server search. A new shared picker (backed by GET /clients/search?q=) is net-new UI + a net-new endpoint.

notes: DUPLICATION RISKS — do NOT rebuild any chrome; every primitive the design names already ships. (1) ShiftContextMenu name collision: import ONLY from @/components/rostering ({ctx,onClose} + ShiftCtxItem/ShiftCtxState). The shifts-page file pages/operations/shifts/components/shift-context-menu.tsx is a different, incompatible component ({x,y,items,onClose}) and pages/my-day/components/stream-context-menu.tsx is a third ({menu,onClose,onAction}); using the wrong one breaks. (2) Hero ambiguity: the design says 'the hero used by /my-day, /health-safety, /emar/prn', but those are NOT the same component — /health-safety + /incidents use the two-cluster hs-hero-kit, while /my-day + /emar/prn use the generic @/components/page PageHero. The design's two-stat-cluster + NZ-chips layout = hs-hero-kit; compose its primitives, don't reach for PageHero. (3) WizardShell vs add-client-dialog: WizardShell is the EXTRACTED reusable chrome; add-client-dialog is its reference instance that still inlines its own rail. Build new wizards on WizardShell + primitives, not by copy-pasting the inlined rail. (4) HeroComplianceBadges is shared by both H&S heroes and must not be mutated for clinical chips — build a separate clinical chip row reusing only its token maps. (5) Two tab systems exist (rostering TabStrip = light toned card strip used by registers; PageTabs = Radix, onDark/overflow used in-hero) — pick TabStrip for the sub-tab rows. SURPRISES: there is genuinely NO shared two-tier group-pill widget (only the _groups.ts data registry + bespoke render in client show.tsx) and NO shared debounced client-search picker — both are assembly work the implementer owns. AttachmentUploader's immediate-POST model conflicts with new-record wizards (record doesn't exist yet) — stage with FileDropzone+StagedFileCard instead, or two-phase submit. All chrome is semantic-token-only (no hardcoded oklch/hex), matching the design's token-mapping requirement; the eslint no-restricted-syntax disables at the top of these files are intentional (bespoke styled-native surfaces) and should be carried into any new wizard files that hand-roll tile/chip/toggle controls.

files.purpose: The clinical module's existing 'thin V1' aggregate service. CRITICAL FINDING: it does NOT currently reference CarePlan, RestraintEvent, or BehaviourSupportPlan at all — so the lens read-queries are net-new here, and the hero's restraint/sign-off chips are currently unbacked.

gaps.description: The clinical module currently has ZERO read-only query path to CarePlan / RestraintEvent / BehaviourSupportPlan. ClinicalDashboardService does not import or query any of them. The lens needs new read-only query methods (cross-client review-due / awaiting-sign-off care-plan list filtered to clinical plan_type; restraint episodes list; PBS plans review list) — added to ClinicalDashboardService or a small new lens service. This is presentation/aggregation only; it reuses the existing tables and must NOT add new tables or write endpoints.

Design handoff (README + GAP §11) repeatedly says the Care Plans register is at '/care-plans'. The ACTUAL URL is '/operations/care-plans' (routes are under prefix('operations'); route name operations.care_plans.index). Any link/button the implementer wires ('Open Care Plans module →', row actions) must use /operations/care-plans or the route name, or it will 404.

The existing /operations/care-plans Index.tsx is a stats-only 'coming soon' dashboard and does NOT render a cross-client plan table (it ignores the controller's paginated carePlans prop and points users to client profiles). So 'link out to the existing register' really means link to the stats page OR (better, for per-plan actions) the per-client profile ?tab=care_plans. The implementer should not assume a working filterable table exists at that URL to deep-link a single plan into; use operations.care_plans.show (/operations/care-plans/{id}) or the client profile tab for row-level 'View'.

RestraintEvent and BehaviourSupportPlan have NO organization_id column and RestraintController::index does NOT org-scope. If the clinical lens runs its own cross-client restraint query for a multi-tenant org, it will leak other orgs' restraint episodes. The lens read-query should join through client.organization_id (or site) to scope, even though the H&S register itself doesn't — flag this so the clinical lens doesn't inherit the leak.

restraint_events.severity is a plain string; the migration comment says low/medium/high but storeEvent validation and the frontend SEVERITY_OPTIONS include 'critical'. updateEvent validation, confusingly, only allows low/medium/high. The lens's severity pill must handle all 4 values (low, medium, high, critical) to avoid an unstyled/blank pill.

The hero compliance chip 'Restraint register · current' and the care-plan sign-off/review counts are not currently produced by ClinicalDashboardService::getKpis() (per GAP §3.5). The lens work must extend getKpis (or feed the hero from a lens service) with restraint_register_current(bool, e.g. derived from active PBS plans / recent episode review state) and clinical care-plan review-due + awaiting-sign-off counts.

notes:
De-dup verdict: there is NO existing duplication to clean up — the clinical module currently has zero awareness of CarePlan/RestraintEvent/BehaviourSupportPlan (ClinicalDashboardService never references them). The real risk is the IMPLEMENTER building a second register. Both registers are single-table systems of record (care_plans; restraint_events + behaviour_support_plans) — the lens reads those exact tables read-only and links OUT.

Three load-bearing corrections to the design handoff: (1) The Care Plans register URL is /operations/care-plans (route operations.care_plans.index), NOT /care-plans as the README/GAP doc repeatedly states — it is mounted under prefix('operations'). (2) That Index page is a stats-only 'coming soon' dashboard that intentionally does NOT render a cross-client plan table (day-to-day management lives in the client profile's Care & Support Plan tab, ?tab=care_plans) — so 'route every action to /care-plans' should in practice route per-plan/per-client actions to the client profile tab (matching where the controller's own redirects send users). (3) Restraints register is /health-safety/restraints (route health-safety.restraints.index), gated by hazards.view.

Org-scoping asymmetry to respect: CarePlan IS org-scoped (organization_id column, controller filters by auth->organization_id). RestraintEvent and BehaviourSupportPlan are NOT (no organization_id, controller does not scope) — the clinical lens must scope its own restraint read-queries through client.organization_id to avoid leaking other tenants' restraint episodes.

Permissions for the lens reads: care-plan lens → care_plans.viewAny; restraint lens → hazards.view (these already exist/seeded). GAP §5 proposes new clinical.* abilities for OTHER tabs (events.review, behaviour.viewAny, monitoring.viewAny) but the two lenses here can ride the existing care_plans.viewAny / hazards.view.

Minor data nuance: restraint_events.severity is a free string allowing 4 values in practice (low/medium/high/critical) despite the migration comment saying 3 — render defensively. updateEvent validation inconsistently caps it at low/medium/high.
